name: mem0-rvaim
description: Local persistent memory for Codex. Self-hosted Mem0 daemon with Qdrant Local + SQLite; workspace-scoped and global memories, no cloud account, no API key.

interface.longDescription: Self-hosted Mem0 daemon with Qdrant Local + SQLite. Workspace-scoped and global memories, no cloud account, no API key. Codex and Claude Code share the same memory store when opened on the same folder.
